page.notes: Italic and roman boundaries within the text are read from the scan at low resolution and may be imperfect. Long s is written as s throughout. The initial D is a decorative woodcut letter joined to DOMINVS. "Iu-" and "Iudais" with consonant I are rendered Ju-, and "iubet" as jubet, per the spelling rule. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. The ornament band and the ghosted show-through letters in the title area are not transcribed.
